overview.short: Cherrapunji is a much-loved hill station in Meghalaya, known for living root bridges and waterfalls.

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Cherrapunji?
faq.a: The best time to visit Cherrapunji is Sep – May. Summers are 12–22°C and winters are 6–16°C.

The nearest airport is Cherrapunji / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Guwahati Railway Station (100 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.

faq.q: How many days are enough for Cherrapunji?
faq.a: 2 days are usually enough to cover the top attractions of Cherrapunji at a relaxed pace.

faq.q: How much does a hotel cost in Cherrapunji?
faq.a: Stays in Cherrapunji start from ₹1,300 per night, with options across 5 price categories.

faq.q: What are the top places to visit in Cherrapunji?
faq.a: The top attractions are Nohkalikai Falls, Double Decker Living Root Bridge, Mawsmai Cave.
